items.title: 3.4.1 Sigma aur pi bonds ka banna (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 3.4.1 and the pi bond section, printed pages 59-61, with Quick Check 3.7.

blocks.text: Sigma (σ) bond tab banta hai jab saath wale atoms ke do aadhe bhare (half-filled) atomic orbitals ek seedhi line mein (linear) overlap karte hain. Orbitals nuclear axis (dono nuclei ko milane wali line) par ek doosre ki taraf aate hain. s aur p dono orbitals aamne saamne (head-on) overlap kar ke sigma bond bana sakte hain.

Ek atom ka s orbital doosre atom ke s orbital se overlap kar ke bond orbital banata hai. Yeh H₂ molecule banne mein hota hai, jahan har hydrogen atom ka s orbital aadha bhara hai. Bond banne ke baad electrons pair ban jate hain aur electron density dono nuclei ke gird barabar (symmetrical) hoti hai (Figure 3.22).

blocks.alt: Hydrogen ke do s orbitals, har ek nucleus wala neela gola, 's Hydrogen' likha, darmiyan jama ka nishan, aur mota teer bayzawi (oval) H2 molecule ki taraf jis mein dono nuclei hain. Oval ke beech se laal teer 'Symmetrical Electron Density' wale dabbe ki taraf.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.22: Do hydrogen atoms ke s orbitals ka overlap jo H2 molecule banata hai (kitab ki Figure 3.22 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Ek atom ka s orbital doosre atom ke p orbital se overlap kar ke covalent bond (σ) bana sakta hai. Maslan HCl mein hydrogen ka aadha bhara s orbital chlorine ke aadhe bhare p orbital se overlap karta hai (Figure 3.23). Cl ki electronegativity zyada hai, is liye electron density Cl ke qareeb zyada hai. Isi liye HCl polar molecule hai.

blocks.alt: Hydrogen atom ka 1s orbital jama chlorine atom ka 3p orbital (dumb-bell). Teer 'Overlap starts' ki taraf, jahan H ka gola Cl p orbital ke ek lobe ko chhoota hai. Phir teer 'Hydrogen chloride HCl' ki taraf, H ki taraf chhota aur Cl ki taraf bara lobe.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.23: s-p overlap se sigma bond ka banna (kitab ki Figure 3.23 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Is overlap ki misal Cl₂ hai, jahan do chlorine atoms ke p orbitals nuclear axis par overlap karte hain. Dono Cl atoms ki electronegativity barabar hai, is liye electron density dono nuclei ke gird barabar hai.

blocks.alt: Chlorine atoms ke do 3p orbitals, 'Atomic orbitals' likha. Teer jahan dono p orbitals Cl nuclei ke darmiyan sire se sire overlap karte hain. Phir teer Cl2 molecular orbital ki taraf: nuclei ke darmiyan bara lobe aur bahar chhote lobes, 'Molecular orbitals' aur 'Molecule' likha.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.24: VBT ke mutabiq p aur p orbitals ka overlap jo Cl2 molecule banata hai (kitab ki Figure 3.24 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: H₂S non-linear molecule hai jo ek sulfur aur do hydrogen atoms se banta hai. Sulfur ke do 3p orbitals (maslan 3py aur 3pz), jin mein ek ek electron hai, do hydrogen atoms ke 1s orbitals se overlap karte hain. Is tarah 92° bond angle wala v-shaped molecule banta hai (Fig. 3.25).

blocks.alt: Baen: mehwaron ke saath sulfur atom aur us ke 3p orbitals: do aadhe bhare 3p orbitals (halke, khaake wale) khare aur neeche-daen mehwar par aur ek bhara 3p orbital (gehra). Aadhe bhare lobes par do H atoms, 'Overlap' likhe khokhle teer, aur un ke darmiyan muRa dohra teer, 90 degrees. Daen: H2S, H-S-H, S par do hare lone pair lobes aur H-S-H zawiya 92 degrees.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.25: H aur S orbitals ke overlap se H2S molecule ka banna (kitab ki Figure 3.25 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Sulfur ke do aadhe bhare 3p orbitals aapas mein 90° par hain; har ek par ek H ka 1s orbital overlap karta hai. Is liye H–S–H angle taqreeban 90° hona chahiye; asal mein yeh 92° hai kyun ke do H atoms ek doosre ko thora sa dhakelte hain. Figure mein 90° orbitals ka angle hai aur 92° molecule ka.

blocks.title: Interesting Information!
blocks.text: H₂O mein bond angle 104.5° hai, jabke H₂S mein 92°. Kitab ke mutabiq is ki wajah yeh hai ke S ke orbitals bare hain aur lone pair zyada dhakelta hai.

Oxygen atoms ke darmiyan double bond (O=O) ka banna dekhein. Har oxygen atom par do unpaired electrons hain jo aapas mein perpendicular (90° par) p orbitals, maslan px aur py, mein hain. Dono atoms ke px orbitals is tarah hain ke aamne saamne (end-to-end) seedhi line mein overlap karte hain; is overlap se σ bond banta hai. Lekin py orbitals dono atoms par parallel (mutawazi, saath saath) hain. Woh pehlu se (sideways) overlap karte hain: do lobes nuclei ki sath ke upar aur do neeche milte hain (Figure 3.26). Is se π bond banta hai. Yun oxygen atoms σ aur π bond se double bonded hain.

blocks.alt: Do oxygen nuclei neele px lobes se jure jo beech mein sire se sire overlap karte hain, jahan gehre oval mein do ulte teer hain, 'sigma bond' likha. Har atom par y lakeer ke saath khare hare py lobes, oopar wale lobe mein oopar teer, Py likha. Laal qausein oopar ke lobes aur neeche ke lobes ko milati hain, har ek par 'pi bond'. Neeche: O=O.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.26: Oxygen atoms ke darmiyan double bond (sigma aur pi) ka banna (kitab ki Figure 3.26 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.prompt: a) H₂O aur N₂ ki orbital structures banayein.
blocks.explanation: H₂O: oxygen ke do aadhe bhare 2p orbitals do hydrogen atoms ke 1s orbitals se overlap karte hain: do s-p σ bonds; oxygen ke do lone pairs angle ko 104.5° tak daba dete hain. N₂: har nitrogen ke teen 2p orbitals mein ek ek electron hai; ek jora (2px) aamne saamne overlap kar ke σ bond banata hai aur baqi do jore (2py, 2pz) pehlu se overlap kar ke do π bonds: triple bond.

blocks.prompt: b) F₂ aur HF ke banne ka orbital overlap dikhayein.
blocks.explanation: F₂: har fluorine ka aadha bhara 2p orbital seedha overlap karta hai: p-p σ bond, density barabar. HF: hydrogen ka 1s orbital fluorine ke aadhe bhare 2p se overlap karta hai: s-p σ bond; density F ki taraf zyada hai, is liye HF polar hai.

items: Sigma bond: nuclear axis par seedha overlap: s-s (H₂), s-p (HCl, polar), p-p (Cl₂). H₂S: S ke do 3p orbitals se 92° angle (H₂O 104.5°).
Pi bond: parallel p orbitals ka pehlu se overlap, axis ke upar aur neeche; O=O ek σ aur ek π bond hai.
